build_afmoe_model: build an AfMoE causal language model with MoE layers, attention, and HuggingFace weight loading
create_afmoe_moe_layer: create a routed MoE layer with expert gate, shared experts, and fused MoE computation
create_afmoe_attention: create an AfMoE attention layer with Q/K normalization, gating, and optional sliding window
